issue.title: [Bug]: Every failed auth with an unknown key writes its own spend rows, so an unauthenticated client decides how large the usage tables grow

scope: Do not write spend rows for unknown or malformed virtual API keys; retain recognized-key failures and non-database logging

overlap_review.35791: Expired Admin UI sessions only; separate known identity case already in main
overlap_review.38493: Preserves metadata for recognized-key budget failures, not unknown key filtering
overlap_review.31006: Sources resolved principal identity, not failure admission
overlap_review.47778: Management and health response error types, not spend persistence

reproduction: probe-main.json records 8 rejected localhost requests and 8 persisted rows in each of three spend tables on clean main
